author: petr1petr
body:
it depends on what you want from your pet - and also what class you are.

They are different kinds of pet

Fey dragon is attacking pet, while pale dragon is more of defensive pet. Some people like it for dispel - removing nasty statuses and debuffs, some like it for miracle - giving you more def/res. so it really depends on what you want.

author: Odeken
body: It's worth it for the dispel. By the time you get to T9 the 1 mil orns won't really be a big deal. I personally use him for most raids.

author: yellowistherainbow
body: I really like it, it dispels quite often.

author: Successful_Badger961
body:
I know I'm in the minority but I don't really care for it.

It has its uses and dispel is handy, but I prefer to use equipment that prevents status effects.

When I was Arcanic/swash I alternated between ori golem for ward and Gwyllgi/war horse for attack. These were the best combos that worked for me.

author: NoShadowdick
body: I think for most players PD is must have pet. Still use it here and there being T10

author: NSA_Chatbot
body: Check out the Phoenix pets next month!  They're great for Arcanics (and anyone, really) because the Deific Channel doubles your everything, plus their own attacks.

author: 27Xenon27
body: Unless you're a pet class you should use Pale dragon. It dispels frequently, it heals a bit, it gives T.def and T.res, really good support pet

author: Marc4360
body: Pale Dragon is a great defensive pet, especially for pvp/wars/territory defense.  It uses dispel pretty frequently which will remove the majority of debuffs, and it also gives you t. res/def +.  It doesn't have much use outside of that though.  Fey Dragon is a great offensive pet for that tier, especially if you have access to Wyrm's buff for additional crit chance.

author: PlanetsInMyPalm
body: Have you built a keep? You can store followers there and swap between them whenever needed.

author: jlmjiggy22
body: Everyone seems like pale dragon for its healing and dispelling. Personally I'm fond of orichalcum golem, I still use it at *9 until I find a fey yeti or something worth changing to.
